title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yaiba, a sword-loving boy, clashes with his rival Onimaru after enrolling in school; when Onimaru is turned into a demon by the cursed Wind God's Sword (Fujinken), Yaiba travels to Mount Tengu for an enchanted sword of his own (VIZ blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates). The danger is that he lacks the skill to control such a weapon. A 24-volume 1988-1993 shounen action comedy by Gosho Aoyama that won the 1993 Shogakukan Manga Award (MangaUpdates).
life_message: It holds up growing in skill and self-control so that power serves you rather than ruling you.
